Specification.Display: Features a large 1.96-inch TFT screen for clear visuals and easy navigation.
Specification.Battery Life: Powered by a 300mAh battery, the watch lasts up to 14 days in battery saver mode and 7-10 days with typical use.
Specification.Connectivity: Supports Bluetooth BLE 5.2 and BT 3.0 for stable and fast connections.
Specification.Build Material: The case is made of durable PC with a premium sprayed finish, paired with a comfortable silicone strap.
Specification.Compatibility: Works with smartphones running Android 5.0+ and iOS 9.0+.
Specification.Supported App: Pairs with the Imiki Life app for enhanced functionality.
Specification.Dimensions: Measures 48 x 40.05 x 10.2 mm, designed for a sleek and comfortable fit.
